response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS excess FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY excess DESC
